title: Inflammatory Cytokines are Associated with the Development of Symptom Burden in Patients with NSCLC Undergoing Concurrent Chemoradiation Therapy
notes: Prospective longitudinal study of 62 NSCLC patients undergoing concurrent chemoradiation (CXRT). Weekly MDASI symptom assessments for 15 weeks + weekly serum cytokines for 8 weeks. Mixed-effect models. IL-6, IL-10, and sTNF-R1 increased significantly during CXRT. sTNF-R1 increase → all 15 MDASI symptoms (est=1.74 SE=0.69 p<.05). IL-6 increase → 5 most severe symptoms: pain fatigue sleep appetite sore throat (est=0.32 SE=0.16 p<.05). V20 (lung volume irradiated) → sTNF-R1 (est=1.77 SE=0.71 p<.01) and total symptom burden. Symptoms peaked at week 8 of CXRT. TNF-α undetectable in all samples. NO cognitive outcomes measured — MDASI measures symptom severity only. ECOG PS 0-1. Platinum-taxane chemo + 64Gy radiation.
null_findings: TNF-α: undetectable in all serum samples
IL-1RA, IL-8, IL-12p40p70: no significant change during CXRT
IL-6 NOT associated with all 15 symptoms (only the top 5 most severe)
Affective symptoms (distress, sadness): no significant change over time
